name: Shellie's Secret
storyline: The game purports to be a "found game" from a Tandy TRS-80 made by an independent developer. The game is set in the role of a police officer who interrogates two characters, a suspect and a witness, to a car accident. In the game's conclusion, the identity of one of the characters is revealed to be different than assumed by the player.
summary: An experimental text-based police interrogation game, in which the player questions a suspect and witness following a car accident. The game is designed to resemble the terminal of a computer from 1985.
